task.instruction: How much does it cost to buy a 16-inch MacBook Pro with the highest-end Max chip Apple currently sells, in its standard memory and storage configuration? Name the chip and its CPU and GPU core counts.

final_answer:
A 16-inch MacBook Pro with the M5 Max chip in its standard configuration costs **$4,399.00** on Apple's US store. That's the Space Black, Standard display model. Apple also lists it at $366.58/mo for 12 months with Apple Card Monthly Installments, or a lease from $87.92/mo for 36 months.

- **Chip:** Apple M5 Max, with a 16-core Neural Engine. The 16-inch model comes only with the M5 Pro or M5 Max. The newer M6 is offered only on the 14-inch.
- **CPU and GPU:** 18-core CPU and 32-core GPU. The page marks this as the included option.
- **Memory and storage:** 36GB unified memory and 2TB storage.

The M5 Max also has an optional 40-core GPU for +$300. Apple says it requires upgrading to 48GB of memory, which raises the price further, so I didn't count it as standard. The Nano-texture display is a +$150 option. I didn't check the price of the Silver version.

judge.rationale: The final page shows a higher M5 Max option (18-core CPU, 40-core GPU) exists; the agent answered the included 18-core CPU/32-core GPU base Max instead.

final_page.title: Buy MacBook Pro, 16-inch, M5 Max Chip, 18-core CPU, 32-core GPU, Space Black, Standard display, 36GB memory, 2TB storage - Apple
